title: Frappe ERPNext 15.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 15.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock module endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated attackers, including portal users or users without roles, to access Serial No and Batch ledger entries without proper permission checks. Attackers can craft requests to retrieve sensitive inventory details such as item codes, quantities, warehouses, batch, and serial numbers.
